description: Election Commission - J. Premadasa was elected as the member of the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a party member ceasing membership. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
